bundle.shortDescription: Offline-first journal, task manager, and local AI companion
bundle.longDescription: A private, offline-first desktop app built around one loop: write a journal entry, and a local llama.cpp model turns the commitments in it into tasks you review and approve. Bring your own GGUF models - nothing is downloaded. Every AI change is a proposal you accept in the Review Inbox, and all data lives in a single encrypted SQLite file on your machine. No internet, no accounts, no cloud.
